assumptions: Conditional timing and assay availability treated as ignorable for this working likelihood, not established by source.
Homogeneous Markov recorded-band dynamics despite A1C temporal averaging, visit triggers and individual heterogeneity.
Observed band taken as the process label; no freely fitted biological-state/measurement-error mixture.
Unmeasured changing treatment included in usual care; never held fixed or absent.
Selected complete available observation sequence only; no inferred death, withdrawal, missed-visit schedule, survival, independent censoring or administrative stop.
assumptions.estimand: Effective homogeneous usual-care switching between recorded A1C bands in this selected available panel, conditional on first recorded band, recorded specimen times and assay availability; no biological, clinical, causal or national hazard claim.
assumptions.likelihood: Sum across labels and consecutive observations log([exp(Q*elapsed_source_days)]previous_band,next_band); exact recorded-band process, not latent disease-state fit.
assumptions.terminal: No terminal contribution after last recorded measurement.
